'''2007 Texas State Championship James Barnes DS Let Them Make The First Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[James Barnes]] at [[2007 Texas State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Let Them Make The First Move / At Last We Will Have Revenge|Ref3-D-letthemmakethefirstmove.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
